findings.highlight: she accepted that it would come to this, two days ago.
findings.evidenceJa: 少なくとも二日前までは
findings.governingReading: 二日前までは gives the latest past period during which she had still accepted the expected duty, followed by losing resolve.
findings.explanation: Having accepted the prospect until two days earlier becomes accepting it two days earlier.

findings.evidenceJa: 今は決心などなくなっている
findings.governingReading: 決心などなくなっている and 意思が欠如していた describe the absence once she knows Shirou is a Master.
findings.explanation: Lost determination and absent will to fight become a gradual waning process.

findings.highlight: Do the Masters have to kill each other?
findings.evidenceJa: マスターは、全員殺さなければいけない
findings.governingReading: 全員 asks whether every Master must die, motivating the precise spare-one-or-two answer.
findings.explanation: Whether all Masters must be killed becomes whether they must kill each other.

findings.highlight: she would work to become someone good enough
findings.evidenceJa: もっと相応しい人でなくてはいけない
findings.governingReading: 彼の隣に座るのは、もっと相応しい人でなくてはいけない follows her excluding herself; she waits beside him only until that other person arrives.
findings.explanation: Another more suitable person being beside Shirou becomes Sakura working to become suitable.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしの前から消していく
findings.governingReading: 姉さんは全てを手に入れる governs 消していく, preserving Sakura’s resentful perception of her sister’s agency.
findings.explanation: Rin removing everything from Sakura becomes those things independently disappearing.

findings.highlight: the events of the last few days.
findings.governingReading: 数日前の出来事 dates the remembered event earlier; it is not a retrospective collection across recent days.
findings.explanation: A dream of events several days ago becomes events of the last few days.
